title: 0.5.5 — The next-departure board
type: changelog
---
- **next: on every transit node.** Upcoming departures at that stop, in feed time order and the feed's own clock ("tram 9 25:10" stays past midnight), capped at three with the hidden rest counted (`+2 more`). Rows before the local query time are gone; when the day's last departure has run, the note says the day is over instead of letting an empty board read as a broken feed.
- **Realtime joins onto the board.** With `SUPERCARTO_GTFS_RT` set, predictions decorate their rows inline — `bus 16 07:05 +300s` or `cancelled` — using the same spec precedence as 0.5.4's live list. Predictions the board has spoken are removed from `live:`, so one fact renders once.
- **Scheduling honesty.** A trip-level prediction decorates only its own trip's rows; another trip's departure stays unsuffixed. A stop with no prediction is unknown, not on time.

314 unit tests (was 310), 121 live, 12 MCP e2e; parity gate green.
